claims.text: Merrywing Bay is a stretch of beach directly in front of the resort, known for calm waters, golden sand and sunsets.

findings.quote: A tranquil stretch of beach located directly in front of Aurora Anguilla. Known for its calm waters, golden sand, and stunning sunsets

claims.text: Rendezvous Bay looks across the channel to St. Martin.

findings.quote: Famous for its turquoise waters and breathtaking views of St. Martin across the channel

claims.text: Accommodations include luxury rooms, suites, villas and estate homes.

findings.quote: Take your pick from Luxury Rooms, Suites, Villas, and Estate Homes.

claims.text: Estate guests have private swimming pools.

findings.quote: Estate guests can lounge by their private swimming pools

claims.text: The resort has six dining options ranging from casual to upscale.

findings.quote: six diverse dining opportunities, each offering a different experience from casual to upscale

claims.text: Chef's Table serves family-style feasts prepared in an open kitchen and wood-burning oven.

findings.quote: Fresh-baked pastries and family-style feasts prepared in an open kitchen and wood-burning oven

claims.text: Tokyo Bay is Executive Chef Joe Richardson's modern take on classic Japanese cuisine, with sushi and sashimi.

findings.quote: Executive Chef Joe Richardson whose deep respect and study of Japanese culture inspired this authentic, modern take on classic Japanese cuisine. Explore a robust menu of fresh sushi and sashimi

claims.text: Sole di Mare serves Mediterranean dishes including handmade pastas and pizzas, with views of the sea and Saint Martin.

findings.quote: From handmade pastas and pizzas to vibrant dishes inspired by the South of France, Greece, Spain, and Morocco
Enjoy your meal while taking in the stunning view of the turquoise-blue sea and the neighboring island of Saint Martin.

claims.text: The International Course's 18th hole begins with a tee shot over a salt pond and climbs forty feet to a green guarded by three bunkers.

findings.quote: It begins with a demanding tee shot over the salt pond, followed by an ascent of forty feet to reach a narrow green meticulously guarded by three imposing bunkers.

claims.text: The Aurora Entertainment Park includes a tennis center, pickleball courts, a climbing wall, beach volleyball, clay bocce, basketball courts and a 9-hole mini golf course.

findings.quote: The new Aurora Entertainment Park features a world-class tennis center, pickleball courts, climbing wall, beach volleyball, clay bocce, basketball courts, and a 9-hole mini golf course.

claims.text: All non-motorized watersport rentals are complimentary and available daily at Rendezvous Beach.

findings.quote: all non-motorized watersport rentals are complimentary and available daily at Rendezvous Beach

claims.text: Guided cave tours are run in partnership with the Anguilla National Trust and Katouche Tours.

findings.quote: guided cave tour, presented in partnership with the Anguillan National Trust and Katouche Tours

claims.text: The resort's golf club has a Greg Norman Signature Design 18-hole International Course and a 9-hole short course, Avalon Links.

findings.quote: Aurora International Golf Club’s stunning Greg Norman Signature Design 18-hole International Course and 9-hole short course, Avalon Links

claims.text: Menus draw on the resort's 10,000-square-foot hydroponic gardens, which supply produce, herbs and fruit every day.

findings.quote: Our menus are crafted by talented chefs, drawing inspiration from the island’s local flavors and our 10,000-square-foot hydroponic gardens.
These gardens provide fresh produce, herbs, and fruits every day.

claims.text: The pool complex has a splash pad, zero-entry pool, lazy river, slide tower and cabanas.

findings.quote: The stunning family-friendly pool complex features a splash pad, zero entry pool, lazy river, slide tower, and private and family cabanas.

claims.text: Sorana Spa has twelve treatment rooms, including two couples suites, with views of Rendezvous Beach.

findings.quote: Our twelve treatment rooms include two couples suites
With luxurious facilities and views of Rendezvous Beach

claims.text: The Aurora Explorers Club offers supervised activities for young guests, including arts and crafts, games and storytelling.

findings.quote: the Aurora Explorers Club invites young guests to discover, create, and connect through a thoughtfully curated program of supervised activities
children can enjoy arts and crafts, games, outdoor activities, storytelling
